section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 5. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 152 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 189 | 550 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
